title: Export each PcbLib footprint to STEP via a board
summary: Places each footprint of a PCB library on the current PCB document as a temporary component (LoadFromLibrary), exports its 3D model with IPCB_Component.SaveModelToFile, and removes it again, leaving the component count unchanged.
phrasings: export library footprints as step files using a board
place a footprint from a library as a temporary component
save a component's 3D model to a .stp file
load a PCB library by file path

commands.name: PcbLibCompToStep
commands.description: Export each footprint of a PcbLib to STEP via the current board
commands.params: Lib=<full path of the .PcbLib> (required)|Out=<folder> (default: temp folder; files are <Out>\<footprint>.stp)
